question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. "Flore."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling is 'Floor.'
 
• 'Floor' means the flat surface of a room on which you walk. (एक कमरे की सपाट सतह जिस पर आप चलते हैं)
 
• Example:
 
 
• *​The huge building has thirty-five** floors.***
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'Flore' is incorrectly spelt among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's know the meaning of the other options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
